verdict.rationale: Medusa is a commerce platform, so accelerated-wallet checkout is a fair question. The pack offers only a bare 'Payment Module' docs title. Nothing in it mentions Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, one-click checkout, or saved payment details that spare buyers from re-entering them.

support.subject: As a merchant, buyers can pay with accelerated wallets — Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, platform one-click — without re-entering details
